verified_key_information_units.information: FY 2025 delivered strong financial performance with revenue increasing 33.9% to EUR 1.837 billion, EBITDA rising 60% to EUR 232.6 million, though net profit decreased to EUR 71.9 million due to one-off consolidation effects from Tallink Grupp.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table showing revenue, EBITDA, and net profit for 12 months 2025 vs 2024; accompanying note explains net profit decrease attributable to one-off effects from Tallink Grupp consolidation in 2024.

candidate_sentences.text: For the 12-month period, the Group reported total revenue of EUR 1,837,000 thousand, compared to EUR 1,371,775 thousand in 2024.
Operating profit for 2025 was EUR 111,061 thousand, compared to EUR 77,024 thousand in 2024, while EBITDA reached EUR 232,581 thousand, compared to EUR 145,415 thousand reported for 2024.

Net profit for the 12-month period stood at EUR 71,969 thousand, down from EUR 193,670 thousand in 2024, with profit attributable to owners of the parent at EUR 72,662 thousand compared to EUR 191,253 thousand in the prior year.

The increase in full-year revenue, gross profit, and EBITDA was primarily driven by the full twelve-month consolidation of Tallink Grupp, whereas Tallink Grupp’s results in 2024 were only consolidated from August onwards.
The decline in net profit compared to the previous year was mainly attributable to one-off effects related to the initial consolidation of Tallink Group recognised in 2024.

verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table (Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024 columns for revenue, EBITDA, and net profit); Events in Q4 2025 section lists factors impacting Q4 financial results.

verified_key_information_units.information: Energy segment increased sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh in Q4 despite lower regional consumption; Elenger secured a multi-year LNG supply agreement for 12 cargoes and expanded battery storage capacity in Latvia while planning further developments in Estonia.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core financial performance of FY 2025 (K1), Q4 2025 results (K2), and liquidity improvements (K7). However, it omits critical details on maritime transport segment developments (K3), energy segment performance and agreements (K4), real estate project advancements (K5), strategic agricultural expansion (K6), and post-reporting events (K8). These omissions include vessel sales, infrastructure projects, biomethane acquisitions, LNG agreements, and loan extensions/acquisitions—all of which are material to the full financial picture. With only three of eight key criteria met and several HIGH-importance items missing, the coverage is insufficient to qualify as generally adequate.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The summary clearly explains the financial performance changes between 2024 and 2025, attributing revenue and profit fluctuations to specific business events (e.g., full-year consolidation of Tallink Grupp). The balance sheet changes are consistently presented, and the cash flow explanation aligns with the reported figures. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization flows logically from income statement highlights to balance sheet and cash flow commentary. All relationships between figures and explanations are internally consistent.
